flags.message: The snapshot records the September 15, 2026 corrected United States merits amicus brief supporting vacatur, but documents.json and the provisioned documents omit merits-amicus-united-states.txt. The staged sg-invited-brief.txt is the different May 20 cert-stage filing. Recovered and used the corrected merits PDF through the official Supreme Court docket; it predates the November 5 cutoff. The gap did not block the forecast.
